text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia and Italy signed an accord to boost cooperation in economic, social and cultural sectors. President Ben Ali ended on Thursday a two-day visit to Rome.
- Participants at meetings of Arab Cities Organisation held in Tunis from May 26-28 approved the setting up of an Arab environment centre.
- Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri asked farmers to modernise techniques and improve stocking capacity for potatoes.
- President Ben Ali on Thursday held a meeting in Rome with Italian Council President Romano Prodi on ways to reinforce relationships and boost bilateral cooperation.
- Important cut in air transport tariffs on the occasion of Tunisian immigrants' return for the summer holiday.
- President Ben Ali says that poverty rate in Tunisia is six percent, down from 40 percent in the 1960s.
